summary.text: R. Lee Ware is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 72nd District, which covers Amelia County, part of Chesterfield County, Nottoway County and Powhatan County, and has served since January 16, 1998.
Ware sits on the House committees on Rules; Finance; and Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources.

paragraphs.text: R. Lee Ware was born in Fitchburg, MA, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Ware's education as Wheaton College, IL (B.A., 1974); Virginia Commonwealth University (continuing education); Harvard College, MA.
The profile gives Ware's occupation as history and government teacher.

Ware's listed memberships and affiliations include St. John Neumann Catholic Church; Virginia State Board of Education (former member); Powhatan County Social Services Board (former member, chairman).
